title: Storm Sorceress Unleashed
description: A silver-haired sorceress in teal armor floats above a chaotic naval battle, wielding a glowing hammer in one hand while casting a swirling vortex of magic from the other. Below her, Viking longships clash amid stormy seas with warriors on horseback charging through crashing waves under a dramatic sky filled with lightning and a massive blue dragon.
prompt: A powerful silver-haired sorceress with long flowing braid floats dynamically above a stormy ocean battlefield, wearing intricate teal and silver armor. She holds a large glowing blue hammer in one hand and unleashes a massive swirling vortex of blue and purple magic from the other. A large blue dragon flies in the turbulent sky filled with dark storm clouds and bright lightning.
